definitions.explanation: A formal term meaning low in price or cost. Unlike {安|やす}い, which is everyday language, {廉価|れんか} is used in written and business contexts and does not carry the negative connotation of poor quality.

examples.japanese: {廉価|れんか}{版|ばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書籍|しょせき}→書籍：04203_shoseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A budget edition of the book was released.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{廉価|れんか}で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This product is inexpensive yet high in quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{廉価|れんか}な⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}している→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧。
examples.english: They are reducing costs by importing inexpensive parts from overseas.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style word. In everyday speech, ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ is used instead. {廉価|れんか} is neutral or even positive — it implies a reasonable or attractive price without suggesting poor quality. The compound {廉価|れんか}{版|ばん} (budget edition, economy version) is especially common for books, DVDs, and software.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {廉価|れんか}{版|ばん}: budget edition, economy version
- {廉価|れんか}な⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: inexpensive product
- {廉価|れんか}で⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧: offer at a low price
- {廉価|れんか}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: budget item
